title: Platform guardrail registry
description: The platform guardrail registry, as defined in The Software Field Guide, issue #84: the citizen-development-on-spec-rails chapter's YAML — the platform's word. The registry declares the data rails a citizen app's binding may ride, and the platform floor each guardrail must meet. A binding that does not ride a declared rail is an escape hatch; a guardrail built below its floor is guardrail drift after a platform upgrade. The registry is maintained by the platform team, not the citizen. This schema mirrors the shape rules of the Rego validator (policies/citizen); the validator additionally enforces the semantic rules a JSON schema cannot — reviewedOn a real calendar date not in the future — and the joins the gate performs against the manifest and the spec.

version.description: Version of the registry. Floors are versioned like the platform that sets them.

reviewedOn.description: Date the registry was last reviewed, YYYY-MM-DD. The validator flags dates in the future.

owner.description: The team that owns the registry. Floors without an owner are floors nobody raises.

dataRails.description: The data rails: the only ways a citizen app's binding may reach data on this platform.

platformFloor.description: The platform floor: the minimum version each guardrail must meet, declared by guardrail name.

name.description: The guardrail the floor governs. Floors are declared by guardrail name.

floor.description: The minimum version that counts as current. Below it is guardrail drift after a platform upgrade.
